{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''jatne ghet'bur'''''<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>, or upper gorget, was a piece of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that protected the wearer's throat and formed part of the [[haalas]]<ref name="TBHC" />, or cuirass. It was an earlier piece of armor, which proved to be too restrictive and hindered the wearer's movement, and by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TBHC" />, was rarely used by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors.
